summary.title: What is CookPilot?
summary.new_body: CookPilot organizes in one place what you are going to eat, what you need to buy, and how to prepare it. You can plan menus, adjust quantities, import recipes, generate shopping lists, and cook step by step, without starting from scratch every day.
summary.new_note: Use it when you want less improvisation and more clarity. Because cooking at home should not always start from an empty screen, an incomplete list, or the same repeated question: 'what should I make today?'
summary.what_is_body: The smart platform that gives you back control of your kitchen.
summary.problem_body: Eliminates daily indecision, improvisation, and food waste.
summary.connects_body: Links menu planning, grocery shopping, nutrition, and guided cooking.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Quick questions about CookPilot
faq.q1: How do I start using CookPilot?
faq.a1: Simply download the app, create an account, and plan your first menu in a minute.
faq.q2: Is it mandatory to track nutrition macros?
faq.a2: No, CookPilot is useful both for planning simple meals and for tracking strict macros.
faq.a3: Costs are referential to help you estimate your budget while shopping.
faq.q4: What benefits does the Pro plan offer?
faq.a4: Unlocks advanced planning, imports from multiple formats, and priority support.
faq.q5: In which stores is the app available?
faq.a5: It is available in Google Play for most devices and Huawei.

cost.label: Cost & savings
cost.modal_title: See what it could cost to put it on the table.
cost.modal_description: In CookPilot, you can check prices, understand ingredient costs and compare what you could save before shopping or cooking.

time.label: Preparation time
time.modal_description: CookPilot connects recipes, steps and timing to help you prepare a meal with clarity. Explore how to organize each preparation in the app.

nutrition.label: Nutrition insights
nutrition.modal_title: Understand what you're about to eat.
nutrition.modal_description: In CookPilot, you can explore calories, macros and other nutrition details for ingredients and meals in the context of your plan.

create_version.label: Create my version
create_version.title: Make it your way.
create_version.description: Tell CookPilot what you want to keep and what you want to change. Adjust ingredients, quantities, technique or preferences and create a personal version ready to plan, shop and cook.

cook_now.label: Cook now
cook_now.title: From recipe to cooking.
cook_now.description: CookPilot turns this recipe into a guided session with steps, timing and continuity so you can focus on cooking.

add_to_plan.label: Add to plan
add_to_plan.title: Put it where you'll actually eat it.
add_to_plan.description: Add it to a meal, day or week and keep servings, ingredients and context connected inside CookPlan.

add_to_shopping.label: Add to shopping
add_to_shopping.title: Turn this recipe into shopping.
add_to_shopping.description: CookList brings its ingredients into one connected list, combines quantities and keeps track of where everything came from.

adjust_goals.label: Adjust to my goals
adjust_goals.title: Make it fit you.
adjust_goals.description: Adjust quantities toward your calorie and macro goals without losing the identity of the food you wanted.

cook_menu.label: Cook menu
cook_menu.title: Cook it as one meal.
cook_menu.description: CookPilot coordinates the preparations so steps, timing, heat, resting and components come together at the table.

save_menu.label: Save
save_menu.title: Save this menu for CookPilot.
save_menu.description: Keep this menu in CookSearch without changing the original.

buy_menu.label: Buy this menu
buy_menu.title: The whole menu. One shopping list.
buy_menu.description: CookList gathers the ingredients from its recipes, combines compatible quantities and keeps their origin clear.

adjust_servings.label: Adjust servings
adjust_servings.title: Make it for the people eating.
adjust_servings.description: Change the servings and let CookPilot recalculate the connected quantities across the menu.

adjust_goals.label: Adjust to my goals
adjust_goals.title: Make this menu work for you.
adjust_goals.description: CookPilot can adjust quantities toward your nutrition goals while keeping the meal recognizable and coherent.

use_day.label: Use this day
use_day.title: Make this day your starting point.
use_day.description: Confirm whether to replace today or save this day to use later.

save_day.label: Save day
save_day.title: Save it to use again.
save_day.description: Keep this day's structure reusable without tying it permanently to a specific date.

adapt_day.label: Adapt this day
adapt_day.title: Tell CookPilot what you want to change.
adapt_day.description: Keep the meals you like and change the rest. CookMatch can reorganize the day from your intent without making you rebuild it.

use_week.label: Use this week
use_week.title: Make this week your starting point.
use_week.description: Confirm whether to replace the current week or save it to use later.

save_week.label: Save week
save_week.title: Save this week to use again.
save_week.description: Keep the complete structure as a saved week, without turning it into a template.

adapt_week.label: Adapt this week
adapt_week.title: Reorganize it your way.
adapt_week.description: Tell CookPilot what you want to keep, change or solve. CookMatch can work on specific days and meal moments without rebuilding what you already want to preserve.

use_list.label: Use this list
use_list.title: Make this list yours.
use_list.description: Bring it into CookList to review, edit and turn it into part of your real shopping flow.

scan_shopping.label: Scan shopping
scan_shopping.title: From a photo to your list.
scan_shopping.description: Scan a list, screenshot, handwritten note or receipt and CookPilot turns the visible food items into an organized list ready to review.

recipes_with_ingredient.label: See recipes with this
recipes_with_ingredient.title: Turn this ingredient into a meal.
recipes_with_ingredient.description: Find recipes that use it and take them into planning, shopping or cooking inside CookPilot.

download_experience.title: Choose where to download
download_experience.description: CookPilot is available on Google Play and AppGallery with the same experience.
